children: NVIDIA (NVDA) beat with strong Q2 results: massive revenue, dominant Data Center sales, high gross margins. Company guided higher revenue and margins for Q3, excluding China Data Center sales.
NVIDIA (NVDA) agreed to backstop at least $105 billion in financing for an OpenAI-linked Ohio data-center project, tying NVDA to the deal’s financing and buildout support.
NVIDIA paused parts of its AI Compute Partnership financing program for cloud providers after internal disagreements and antitrust concerns, briefly weighing on NVDA intraday trading.
NVIDIA (NVDA) agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.9B, expanding its AI tooling and open-source ecosystem—news relevant to NVDA traders tracking strategic AI M&A and platform growth.
Michael Burry bought December NVDA call options in the mid‑to‑high $200s as a hedge after NVDA beat quarterly estimates and management forecast ~70% long‑term growth through fiscal 2028.
TrendForce forecasts NVIDIA rack-scale AI systems (NVL72, GB300, Vera Rubin) to drive over $710B output value by 2027, with shipments rising 50%+ and pricier VR200 systems gaining share.
Goldman Sachs raised NVIDIA (NVDA) price target to $300 from $285. Analyst notes demand surpasses 100%, memory and component shortages limit shipments, and buybacks may boost shares in six months.
NVIDIA (NVDA) reported holding about $21 billion in SpaceX stock — roughly 122.8 million shares as of June 30 — marking SpaceX as a major external investment for NVDA.
Traders note risk to Hugging Face’s neutrality after the NVIDIA (NVDA) deal; concern that perceived NVIDIA/CUDA alignment could hurt platform value, while openness to competitors may limit downside.
NVIDIA (NVDA) on Aug 25, 2026 launched the Jetson Orin Nano 2, claiming 2x inference speed vs prior model and 40% lower power at same performance; platform has 3M+ developers and named adopters.
